title: Benson education plan: Up teacher pay, tackle absenteeism, change constitution
summary_en: Benson’s plans include continuing signature efforts of the Whitmer administration and several ideas that would need support from the Legislature.
author: Isabel Lohman

title: As MSU president exits, what the heck is going on? We have (some) answers
summary_en: Kevin Guskiewicz said board members had ‘differing perspectives’ on how MSU should move ahead. Gov. Gretchen Whitmer called his departure disappointing but not surprising.
author: Kim Kozlowski
title_cn: As MSU president exits, what the heck is going on? We have (some) answers

title: MSU loses another president, in spite of $1 million pay raise
summary_en: MSU President Guskiewicz is set to become the next president of Clemson University in South Carolina even after board voted to increase his annual salary to $2 million.
author: Kim Kozlowski
title_cn: MSU loses another president, in spite of $1 million pay raise
